representation: The group controller commits the group. A member commits itself only.

contribution.capacity: up to 60 percent of the shared inference entitlement
contribution.accounts: none; the member's account stays the member's

obligations: Assigned parts by their deadlines; handover of unfinished parts on exit.
exit: Either side, with 7 days notice; assigned parts are finished or handed over first.
note: Declared by the member on chain; ending the membership by either side then changes the member's boundary, and the member can change the declaration, which reopens its boundary-bound conclusions.
